breedingMechanic.formula: child = pal with BreedingPower closest to floor((p1.BP + p2.BP + 1) / 2). Tiebreaker: lower InternalIndex. Special/Tower-boss/variant pairs override this rule.
breedingMechanic.activeSkill: 50% chance to inherit one move from a parent's full learnset (exclusives blocked).
breedingMechanic.ivs: Each of HP/ATK/DEF: 30% father / 30% mother / 40% random mutation.
breedingMechanic.wikiVersion: Mechanic introduced 0.1.2.0; wiki page reflects through 0.3.1.0.
